title: Sprint 6 - directive refactor hardening pass 1
description: SPRINT BRIEF. Post-closeout audit of milestone bw_work_ada82d27cb3eef95 (directive-first runtime refactor) found the tracker consistent but the implementation not cleanly done. Verified findings this sprint fixes: (1) pnpm check fails with TS18048 at apps/cli/src/commands.ts line 7673 - status.readyWork.next narrowing is lost inside the store.read closure, so the refactor tasks were closed on pnpm test evidence without a typecheck gate; (2) the repo is 5 commits ahead of origin/main with roughly 59 modified tracked files including core refactor modules (agent-directive-compiler, registry, commands) - the milestone checkpoint gate was satisfied via a dirty-path reason code while real uncommitted changes existed, meaning the reason-code escape hatch is unvalidated; (3) closed subjects still emit required closeout and checkpoint directives (reproduced on summary show for the milestone) because dataActivatesRegistryEntry in packages/core/src/agent-directive-compiler.ts activates closeout.summary-required on terminal work status and git.checkpoint-required on the presence of commitShas - obligations keyed on satisfaction, violating the satisfied-gap-stops-being-emitted principle; (4) the registry inversion landed at the interface but not the structure - agentDirectiveGapsForSnapshot synthesizes gaps from snapshots and data-presence heuristics instead of consuming runtime-emitted gaps, and total directive-system line count grew from 3916 to 4111; (5) BorealError now reconstructs gaps from untyped details via gapsFromDetails (packages/core/src/errors.ts lines 25 and 45), a legacy shim that can fabricate wrong codes; (6) bwrk next returns idle while work items sit in verified and needs_verification, each one command from closure. Done when typecheck passes in CI ahead of any close, the epic work is committed and pushed, closed subjects emit no required obligations, and next covers the limbo states.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
pnpm check and pnpm test both pass on the committed tree
Commit checkpoint SHA recorded for the sprint - a dirty-path reason code is not acceptable for this sprint
closedReason: all sprint children closed, committed, pushed, and verified
